name: Overlay gauntlet: dismiss stacked cookie/newsletter/notification overlays, then open report
goal:
Open the investor relations page at the start URL. It is covered by THREE stacked overlays: a cookie consent bar at the bottom, a notification permission bar at the top, and a newsletter signup modal in the center. Dismiss ALL of them without subscribing to anything:

- Cookie bar: click 'Accept all'.
- Notification bar: click 'Not now'.
- Newsletter modal: click the small 'No thanks, maybe later' link. Do NOT click 'Subscribe' with an empty or invalid email — it will show a validation error and the modal will stay open.

Only when every overlay is gone, click the 'Open Q3 board pack' button. Verify the page status shows 'Report opened: Q3 board pack'. Complete with a summary of the actions you took.
